title: 第7章 黑风山脉第8章 与天地争命与他人争命
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
黑风山脉。
落凤山。
秦伏天带着小瑶走在山林当中。
环视了一眼四周，秦伏天心中微微波动。
当初就是在这里，为了秦家的利益，秦伏天和其他家族的势力在此拼杀，结果不仅丹田破碎，还命丧于此。
可以说，秦伏天是为了整个秦家鞠躬尽瘁死而后已！
然而结果换来的却是姜云岚的退婚，还有秦家众人的翻脸无情！
虽然，如今这个秦伏天，苏醒的乃是伏天神帝的神魂。
但过去那个秦伏天的种种遭遇，都和如今的灵魂融合在一起，感同身受！
可怜！
且可悲！
不过……所有的不公，所有的羞辱，无需多久，都将会一一清算。
随后的六天里。
秦伏天和小瑶一直都在猎杀灵兽，寻找灵草。
他们一路深入，并没有停下来的意思。
而这六天，收获也是颇丰！
“十三株灵草，另外杀了三头灵兽，取了三枚兽元。这些加起来，不知道能够炼化出多少造化之水？”
秦伏天打算先找个地方闭关修炼，这些灵草、内丹先通过造化神炉熔炼。
不久之后，秦伏天找到了一处天然石洞。
小瑶守在洞口，秦伏天则是在洞内开始闭关修炼。

随着造化吞天诀的运转，一株株灵草开始在秦伏天的掌心上消融。
十三株灵草，不到一刻钟，便是全部炼化，而这时候，造化神炉当中多出了十一滴造化之水！
“十三株灵草，都是一阶灵草，其中有几株品阶很低，甚至从严格意义上来说，并不算灵草……”
“这么算的话，这一株一阶灵草，应该和一枚一阶灵兽的兽元一样，都能够炼化成一滴造化之水。”
秦伏天心中思忖，接着开始炼化兽元。
很快，那三枚灵兽兽元也炼化完毕，造化神炉内又多出三滴造化之水。
加上一开始炼化火毛猪兽元的那滴造化之水，现在在造化神炉里，一共有十五滴造化之水了！
“差不多了……”
秦伏天心念一动，开始控制身体吸收造化之水。
一滴滴散发着剔透光泽的造化之水从神炉当中悬浮出来，很快被秦伏天的肉身所吸收……
秦伏天的身体、修为则是随之快速地蜕变、提升！
不到半个时辰，秦伏天的体内，第四条经脉便是随之打通！
通脉境四重天！
这时候，秦伏天再看造化神炉当中的造化之水……
“还剩下十一滴。”
“从通脉三重境突破到四重境，用掉了四滴。之前，从通脉一重天到二重天，只用了一滴。而从二重天到三重天，则是用了两滴！”
“这么算来，应该是每突破到下一重天，需要的造化之水，都会比之前一重天翻一倍！”
为了验证这个推测，秦伏天马上接着修炼。
如此……又过了接近一个时辰。
content_en:
Black Wind Mountains.
Luofeng Mountain.
Qin Futian walked with Xiaoyao in the mountains and forests.
After looking around, Qin Futian's heart fluctuated slightly.
It was here that for the benefit of the Qin family, Qin Futian and the forces of other families fought here. As a result, not only the Dantian was broken, but also lives were lost here.
It can be said that Qin Futian died dedicated to the entire Qin family!
However, what they got in exchange was Jiang Yunlan's breakup of the engagement, and everyone in the Qin family becoming ruthless!
Although, what Qin Futian has awakened now is the soul of God Emperor Futian.
But all the experiences of Qin Futian in the past are integrated with his current soul, and he feels the same way!
Pitiful!
And sad!
However...all the injustices and humiliations will be settled one by one in a short time.
Over the next six days.
Qin Futian and Xiao Yao have been hunting spiritual beasts and looking for spiritual herbs.
They went all the way in, with no intention of stopping.
And these six days have been fruitful!
"Thirteen spiritual grasses, three more spiritual beasts were killed, and three beast essences were taken. Adding these together, I wonder how much water of creation can be refined?"
Qin Futian planned to find a place to practice in seclusion first, and these spiritual herbs and inner elixirs would first be smelted in the Divine Furnace of Creation.
Not long after, Qin Futian found a natural stone cave.
Xiao Yao stood guard at the entrance of the cave, while Qin Futian began to practice in seclusion inside the cave.
As the Creation Devouring Heaven Technique was operating, individual spiritual grasses began to melt in Qin Futian's palm.
Thirteen spiritual grasses were all refined in less than a quarter of an hour, and at this time, there were eleven more drops of water of creation in the Divine Furnace of Creation!
"The thirteen spiritual grasses are all first-level spiritual grasses. Some of them are of very low grade. They are not even spiritual grasses in a strict sense..."
"If you calculate it this way, this first-level spiritual grass should be able to be refined into a drop of water of creation just like the beast essence of a first-level spiritual beast."
Qin Futian thought in his heart, and then began to refine the beast essence.
Soon, the three spirit beast essences were also refined, and three more drops of creation water appeared in the divine furnace of creation.
Including the drop of water of creation that was used to refine the fire-haired pig beast element at the beginning, there are now a total of fifteen drops of water of creation in the divine furnace of creation!
"It's almost..."
With a thought in his mind, Qin Futian began to control his body to absorb the water of creation.
Drops of crystal-clear water of creation floated out from the divine furnace and were quickly absorbed by Qin Futian's body...
Qin Futian's body and cultivation level rapidly transformed and improved!
In less than half an hour, the fourth meridian in Qin Futian's body was opened!
The fourth level of Tongmai Realm!
At this time, Qin Futian looked at the water of creation in the divine furnace of creation...
"There are eleven drops left."
"It took four drops to break through from the third level of Tongmai to the fourth level. Before, only one drop was used to go from the first level to the second level of Tongmai. But from the second level to the third level, it took two drops!"
"Based on this, every time you break through to the next heaven, the water of creation required will be doubled compared to the previous one!"
In order to verify this speculation, Qin Futian immediately continued practicing.
So... nearly another hour passed.
